messages:
Nora (marketing): Quick sync: targeting Wed release. Need final changelog link, docs examples, three-line benchmark bullets, and webinar demo owner by EOD Mon. Who can take demo? @Carlos?
Carlos (eng): I can. Plan: show canary flow + live dashboard. Need stable changelog URL and sample with new cache header.
Mei (eng): Changelog draft at https://redwood.internal/changelog/1.4-draft. Added X-Dispatch-Cache header examples.
Zoe (docs): I'll update quickstart with curl/python examples and a note about default batch sizing. Pub window: 08:30 PT release morning.
Jules (marketing): Marketing wants 3 bullets: p50 reduction, token-cost %, and throughput gain. Also short privacy line for the post.
Dan (product): Use conservative numbers: p50 ~45% down on 2k seqs, p95 ~28% down, unit cost ~18% lower with cache + dynamic batching. I'll DM the spreadsheet.
Nora (marketing): Webinar 10am PT on release day. Carlos demo, Dan product narrative, Nora moderates. Slides + bench graphs needed.
Carlos (eng): Slide asks: architecture diagram (cache + batching), before/after charts, canary plan. Demo script coming EOD Mon.
Mei (eng): Bench CSVs: s3://bench-artifacts/rls-1712/metrics.csv. Use that for plots. Canary ramp: 2% -> 20% -> full by +90min if healthy. Rollback: rb rollback --id rls-1712 --reason "regression"
Zoe (docs): Legal-approved privacy blurb: "Data remains customer-owned and can be hosted in your VPC for Private deployments." I'll insert in post and docs.
Jules (marketing): Inbound routing: CTA posts utm_campaign=rls-1712 and model_hint=redwood-opt. Sales webhook is https://hooks.redwood.com/leads. Who can smoke-test?
Carlos (eng): I'll run a staging smoke test: curl -X POST https://hooks.redwood.com/leads -d '{"email":"test@example.com","utm_campaign":"rls-1712","model_hint":"redwood-opt"}' and report results.
deploy-bot: Preflight queued: docs_publish, changelog_pin, cdn_purge, webhook_smoke_test, webinar_slides. Will post status updates.
Nora (marketing): Final owners: slides (Jules), demo script (Carlos), docs publish (Zoe), changelog pin (Mei), webhook test (Carlos), bench confirm (Mei). Dry run Sat 09:00 PT. If anything blocks, drop here and @Nora.
